title: Minimum Interval to Include Each Query
description: Given a 2D array intervals where intervals[i] = [left_i, right_i] and an array queries, for each query return the size of the smallest interval containing it, or -1 if no interval contains it.

interfaces.name: minInterval
interfaces.signature: def minInterval(self, intervals: list[list[int]], queries: list[int]) -> list[int]:
